author: Epic Games
description:
Roco Kingdom is a new evolution of open-world creature collecting games, where players become Rocos and set out to meet Jinies, the native creatures living in the continent of Carosia.  

Discover 400+ unique Jinies in this living open world. Form bonds with them as you grow together, and put your strategy to the test in fair tactical PvP where skill matters more than stats.  

Wishlist Now: https://epic.gm/roco-kingdom
title: Roco Kingdom Official Trailer | Wishlist Now

author: Epic Games
description:
Get your first look at Rainbow Six Tactics: a brand-new single-player Rainbow Six game, featuring Siege operators and turn-based gameplay.  

Wishlist now: https://epic.gm/tc-rainbow6

Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics is a single‑player tactical game set in the Rainbow Six universe. Command elite operators in tense turn‑based battles, breach through destructible environments, and outsmart enemies with synchronized assaults. Upgrade your HQ between missions to unlock gear and unravel a global conspiracy.
title: Rainbow Six Tactics | Reveal Trailer
